trans-unit.source: State lists start collapsed. Clicking a state-list tab, or pressing Enter or Space on it, expands its list; activating the expanded tab again collapses all lists. While a list is expanded, Left and Right Arrow, Home, and End select another state-list tab and keep keyboard focus on the full tab; while all lists are collapsed, they only move focus between tabs. Clicking a tab moves focus to the first item in its list. Tab moves through the information buttons beside each tab label and into the expanded list. Enter or Space on an information button shows that list's details without selecting its tab. The list area keeps its height when you change tabs. Use arrow keys in a list and Enter to open its selected item. A pill's status section expands and focuses its list. Autopilot is collapsed by default; its heading expands or collapses its rules, and its separate switch enables all available rules or turns them off. Policy dropdowns remain visible while rules are off. Selecting a policy while off does not enable the rule; turning the switch on uses the displayed policy without asking again. Policy selections, expanded tabs, and Autopilot expansion choices are remembered when reopening the artifact.
trans-unit.target: Списки штатів спочатку згорнуті. Автопілот за замовчуванням згорнутий; його заголовок розгортає або згортає його правила, а його окремий перемикач активує всі доступні правила або вимикає їх.
